Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Prime Monster, a card-based strategy roguelike developed by Cavalier Game Studios. Players will take to the political landscape to compete for votes, endure campaign-ending scandals, and survive a parliament of monsters. Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Red Recon: 1944, an isometric strategy stealth game developed by Varangs. Players will command a Soviet squad into battle across East Prussia in 1944. Overcome daring missions, make use of a variety of weapons, and utilize the art of stealth wherever necessary. Red Recon: 1944 is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

author: IGN
description:
Updates to the KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy series will be coming to the sci-fi strategy games. In collaboration with a team led by KKND  series modder Andre ‘IceReaper’ Mohren, Krush Kill 'N Destroy Xtreme (1997) and Krush Kill 'N Destroy 2: Krossfire (1998) will add modern online PvP multiplayer to Steam and GOG. Watch the latest KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy series trailer to see what to expect with this update, which also brings new patches that will introduce additional display resolutions, game balance improvements, improved support for mods, additional playable languages, and fixes to known issues with the previous releases. The KKND series updates will be available in June 2026 on PC via Steam and GOG.

title: KKND: Krush Kill 'N Destroy - Official Series Major Update Announce Trailer

Take a look at the Launch Trailer for Bandit Trap, a chaotic multiplayer game developed by Picomy. Players will assemble their crews to defend or attack the house in search of loot. Make the right gear selections, evade traps, and claim treasures for victory. Bandit Trap is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
